reviewer: Codex source review under maintainer instruction; not a human sign-off
review_method: Public repository opened in Codex web; pinned README, implementation and LICENSE retrieved from public raw URLs and inspected. No upstream code executed.
identity_check: Exact repository owner/name checked; same-name projects and legacy aliases not merged by name.
role_findings_zh: 调用方提供证据、主张或候选集合；工具构造有界问题发送给 Jev，并返回概率和类型化结果供调用方处理。
role_findings_en: The caller supplies evidence, claims or candidates. Tools construct bounded Jev questions and return probabilities and typed results for the caller to handle.
limitations_zh: 作者的速度与费用说法未在本库复测。判断只针对提供的证据，不等于独立查证事实。此项目与同一作者的浏览器工具分别对应不同仓库与用途。
limitations_en: Speed and cost claims were not tested here. Judging supplied evidence is not independent fact discovery. This server and the same author’s browser tool are distinct repositories with different purposes.

sources.inspected_scope: Project overview, Jev role, installation entry and limitations; full file captured, not every unrelated feature audited.
Targeted API client, provider, decision or routing symbols; not an exhaustive code/security audit.
Captured supporting implementation; not independently inspected in full. Admission relies on README and the separately inspected judgment definitions/client.
License text and attribution boundary; not a legal opinion.
